A_gt_provenance.detail: GT is dataset filename identity/camera/scene, not model predictions. All 2,678 official manifest records match filename parsing; train identities155 are disjoint from evaluation identities155. Full query591/gallery1055 metadata in all five NPZ archives agrees exactly with the official manifest; query identities52, scenes30, cameras8. Stable ascending ranking removes only same-ID AND same-scene records. All591 queries are valid in every case.

B_score_normalization.detail: AP averages precision at all relevant ranks; INP is relevant count divided by last relevant rank; CMC is first-hit cumulative success. Percent conversion multiplies by100. There is no score division by model-output extrema. Square-root block factors implement squared-distance coefficients (1-w)/.75 and w/.25. Unit descriptor normalization is separate from evaluation-score normalization.
